intro.tagline: Download and keep whole podcast archives: in bulk, integrity-checked, even on a NAS.

credits.author: by Simone Pizzi — Runtime Radio
credits.llm: written with the help of language models (Gemini, Claude)

topbar.check_all_hint: Check every feed now: new episodes, automatic archiving

queue.status_offline_hint: downloads restart when the network is back

banner.offline: You are offline: the queue is paused and restarts on its own when the connection is back. Partial files are kept and each download resumes where it stopped.

home.title: Your library
home.text: Every feed, with what is archived and what is left to download. Click a feed to open it.

welcome.title: Welcome to FeedDownloader Pro
welcome.text: Add a podcast’s RSS feed: you can download all its episodes, or just those of a period, and keep the archive up to date by itself.
welcome.drop_hint: You can also drag an address from the browser onto the window.
welcome.step1_text: Paste the RSS address or import an OPML list from another app.
welcome.step2_text: In Settings → Downloads: a local or external disk, or a network folder (NAS).
welcome.step3_text: Download in bulk, filter by date, turn on automatic archiving for new episodes.

addFeed.title: Add a feed
addFeed.subtitle: The podcast’s RSS address, usually found next to the subscribe buttons.
addFeed.url_hint: “https://” may be left out. RSS and Atom feeds are accepted.
addFeed.already: This feed is already in the library.
addFeed.auto_desc: New episodes found by the periodic checks are downloaded without asking.

feedError.not_a_feed: The address leads to a web page, not to an RSS feed.
feedError.rate_limited: This feed was just requested: try again in a few seconds.
feedError.not_found: The feed no longer exists at this address (error 404).
feedError.forbidden: The server refused the request: the feed may be private.
feedError.network: The server is not answering. Check the connection.
feedError.generic: The feed could not be read.

feed.auto_desc: When a check finds new episodes in this feed, they are downloaded by themselves. Checks run at startup and at the interval chosen in Settings → General.
feed.panel_hint: Click an episode title to see its details here.
feed.plan_filtered: The episodes shown with the current filters, not archived yet.
feed.plan_selection: The selected episodes, not archived yet.
feed.plan_hint: The estimate uses the size declared by the feed or, when missing, the duration.

episodes.no_audio: This episode has no audio file

confirm.download_body_one: {{count}} episode of “{{podcast}}” goes into the queue.
confirm.download_body_other: {{count}} episodes of “{{podcast}}” go into the queue.
confirm.space_warning: Free space may not be enough. Downloads that don’t fit will stop with “disk full”.
confirm.remove_body: “{{podcast}}” leaves the library. Files already downloaded stay on disk and in the archive.
confirm.reset_body: The episode leaves the archive and goes back to the ones to download. The file on disk is not deleted.
confirm.auto_body_one: From now on new episodes download by themselves. There is also {{count}} episode already published and not archived: download it now?
confirm.auto_body_other: From now on new episodes download by themselves. There are also {{count}} episodes already published and not archived: download them now?
confirm.auto_with_missing_one: Turn on and download the missing one
confirm.auto_with_missing_other: Turn on and download the {{count}} missing

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle_idle: Nothing downloading. The queue, the failed and this session’s completed downloads show up here.
downloads.subtitle_running: The queue works in the background: the window can be closed, the app stays in the notification area.
downloads.subtitle_paused: The queue is paused: partial files are kept and resume where they stopped.
downloads.subtitle_offline: You are offline: the queue restarts on its own when the connection is back.
downloads.pending_title: Downloads interrupted when the app last closed
downloads.empty_queue_text: Open a feed and choose what to download: everything, a period or a selection.
downloads.empty_done_text: Episodes archived during this session will show up here.
downloads.stop_body_one: {{count}} download is cancelled and its partial file deleted.
downloads.stop_body_other: {{count}} downloads are cancelled and their partial files deleted. To suspend without losing anything, use “Pause”.

errors.not_found: The file no longer exists on the server (404).
errors.stalled: The transfer stalled for over a minute.
errors.timeout: The server didn’t answer in time.
errors.permission: The download folder is not writable.
errors.content_type: The server answered with a web page instead of audio.
errors.too_large: The file exceeds the size limit you set.
errors.private_ip: The address points to the local network: blocked for safety.
errors.http_server: The server had a problem: try again later.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Every downloaded episode, with the data recorded at download time.
archive.load_error: The archive could not be read.
archive.empty_text: Downloaded episodes show up here, with size, quality and SHA-256 fingerprint.
archive.search_placeholder: Title, podcast, file name or date…

health.title: Archive verification
health.subtitle: Checks that every archived episode is in place and intact.
health.mode_quick_desc: Checks that every file exists and has the recorded size. Takes a few seconds even on large archives.
health.mode_full_desc: Also recomputes each file’s SHA-256 fingerprint and compares it with the one recorded at download: it finds damaged files even when their size didn’t change. On large archives or a NAS it can take a long time; it can be stopped.
health.cancelled: Check stopped: the results cover the first {{count}} episodes.
health.all_ok: All good: every file is present and intact.
health.missing_desc: Moved, renamed or deleted. “Find moved files” looks for them in the podcast folder and recognises them by their SHA-256 fingerprint, even under a new name.
health.repair_result: {{repaired}} files found and relinked · {{unmatched}} not found.
health.mark_missing: Mark the missing ones as not downloaded
health.mark_title: Mark the missing files as not downloaded?
health.mark_body_one: {{count}} episode leaves the archive and goes back to the ones to download.
health.mark_body_other: {{count}} episodes leave the archive and go back to the ones to download. If the files were only moved, try “Find moved files” first.
health.corrupted_desc: The file on disk is no longer the one downloaded: damaged, or modified (ID3 tags written by another program, or by versions up to 1.5.x, which computed the fingerprint before writing tags). If the file plays correctly, it can be accepted as the new reference.
health.rebaseline: Accept the current files as reference

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Downloads, files, archive, accessibility and information about the program.
settings.language_desc: Applies to the interface and to system notifications.
settings.refresh_desc: How often the app looks for new episodes in every feed, also with the window closed to the notification area. Feeds with automatic archiving download what they find right away.
settings.folder_desc: Each podcast gets its own subfolder. An external disk or a network folder (NAS, SMB) works too.
settings.folder_choice_body_one: There is {{count}} episode already archived in the current folder. You can move it to the new folder, or leave it where it is and use the new one only for future downloads: either way the app keeps finding it.
settings.folder_choice_body_other: There are {{count}} episodes already archived in the current folder. You can move them to the new folder, or leave them where they are and use the new one only for future downloads: either way the app keeps finding them.
settings.migrate_partial: {{moved}} folders moved, {{errors}} not moved: those files stay in the previous folder and the app still finds them.
settings.migrate_busy: Wait for the downloads to finish before moving the archive.
settings.migrate_nested: The new folder can’t be inside the current one, nor contain it.
settings.path_not_writable: The chosen folder is not writable.
settings.path_timeout: The network folder is not answering.
settings.path_network: Network folder: if the share disconnects, running downloads stop and resume later.
settings.transfer_desc: Each download retries by itself up to 5 times on transient errors, and resumes partial files from where they stopped.
settings.speed_hint: Total for all downloads together: {{value}} KB/s.
settings.naming_desc: What each downloaded file is called. Applies to future downloads: existing files are not renamed.
settings.naming_note: {season} and {episode} are the feed’s iTunes numbers, two digits (“00” when missing). Characters not allowed in file names are removed.
settings.sidecar: Save metadata next to the files
settings.sidecar_desc: For each episode a .json file with title, date, notes, numbering, addresses and SHA-256 fingerprint; for each podcast a podcast.json and the cover. The archive stays readable even when the feed disappears.
settings.id3_desc: Title, podcast and year; the cover only if the file has none. The publisher’s tags (chapters, comments) are kept.
settings.opml_desc: To bring feeds in from, or out to, another podcast app. Importing doesn’t change feeds already in the library.
settings.temp_desc: Removes the .part files left by interrupted downloads that won’t be resumed.
settings.temp_busy: Wait until the queue is empty.
settings.danger_desc: Empties the archive and the download history: every episode goes back to “to download”. Files on disk are not touched.
settings.reset_body: The archive and the history are emptied and can’t be recovered. Files stay on disk, but the app won’t recognise them as downloaded any more.
settings.zoom_desc: Enlarges text and controls. Also with Ctrl + and Ctrl −, Ctrl 0 to go back to 100%.
settings.motion_desc: Removes transitions and animations. If you already asked the operating system, they are reduced anyway.

toast.disk_critical: Almost no space left ({{free}} free): downloads not started.
